scenes.text: Did you know you aren't the only person living inside your head?
Deep inside your brain is a thick band of nerves called the corpus callosum, which links your left and right hemispheres.
In famous medical studies, patients would put on a shirt with their right hand, while their left hand immediately started unbuttoning it because it wanted a different outfit.
Do you think you are actually in control of your left hand, or is it someone else?
